# Kernel Loader ### Automated Kernel Module Loader and Diagnostic Suite for Android **Detects running kernel · Downloads matching module · In-app verification** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/bmjubairdadu/kernel-loader?style=flat-square)](../../releases/latest) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Android%209%2B%20arm64-green?style=flat-square)](#requirements) [![Root](https://img.shields.io/badge/root-Magisk%20%7C%20KernelSU%20%7C%20APatch-red?style=flat-square)](#requirements) [![License: GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL%20v3-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
--- **Kernel Loader** is a root-powered Android application designed to resolve, download, insert, and verify kernel modules (`.ko`) across Linux kernels 4.9 through 6.12. It matches the exact running kernel against a live OTA driver catalog, verifies real-time physical memory read/write access via an integrated verification binary (`Driver.sh`), and packages complete hardware diagnostic dumps for custom driver compilation. --- ## Key Features - **Unified Load Pipeline**: Automatically matches the exact kernel version, downloads the compatible driver from the live OTA repository, and loads it into kernel space. - **In-App R/W Verification**: Direct execution of the `Driver.sh` memory engine within the terminal screen to verify physical memory read and write operations. - **Detailed Error Reporting**: When a module load fails, the loader extracts and displays the root cause directly from kernel ring buffers (`dmesg`), avoiding generic verification errors. - **Diagnostic Report Pack**: Generates a self-contained ZIP archive containing: - Exact `boot.img` partition dump (detected via active A/B slot and block device mapping). - Full kernel symbol table (`/proc/kallsyms`). - Sample OEM vendor module (`.ko`) with extracted compiler vermagic and configuration. - Decompressed kernel configuration (`/proc/config.gz` or `/proc/config`). - Kernel ring buffer logs (`dmesg`) and live application logs. - **One-Tap Sharing**: Direct integration with WhatsApp and Telegram with full FileProvider permission handling and clip-data propagation. - **Security and Hardening**: - Full-mode R8 code shrinking and class obfuscation. - Runtime anti-tamper shield detecting Frida, debuggers, ptrace, and Xposed hooks. - Network security configuration enforcing direct connections (`NO_PROXY`). --- ## Screenshots | Home | Live Terminal | |---|---| | ![Home](docs/screenshots/main.png) | ![Console](docs/screenshots/console.png) | --- ## Requirements | Component | Requirement | |---|---| | Root Provider | Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch (Superuser access required) | | Architecture | ARM64 (aarch64) | | Android Version | Android 9.0 (API level 28) or higher | | Connectivity | Internet connection for OTA driver catalog and updates | --- ## Execution Workflow ```text Tap LOAD │ ├─► Pre-flight validation (Root check, Kernel release, Architecture) │ ├─► OTA catalog resolution (Exact kernel match from repository) │ ├─► Download and integrity verification │ ├─► Staged insmod execution via root shell │ └─► Device node verification and live dmesg validation ``` --- ## Diagnostic Report Structure When building custom drivers for unsupported kernels, the generated ZIP archive includes: ```text report__.zip ├─ boot.img Raw boot partition dump (kernel + ramdisk + dtb) ├─ boot_info.txt Block device path, header version, and sizes ├─ kallsyms.txt Kernel symbol addresses (/proc/kallsyms) ├─ sample_vendor_module.ko Real OEM module from /vendor/lib/modules ├─ vendor_modinfo.txt Compiler version, vermagic, and module info ├─ config.txt Kernel configuration options (IKCONFIG) ├─ dmesg.txt Kernel ring buffer tail and insmod error details ├─ applog.txt Application execution console log ├─ proc_cmdline.txt Kernel boot arguments ├─ proc_version.txt Kernel compiler and toolchain identification ├─ proc_cpuinfo.txt CPU hardware specifications ├─ device_props.txt Android system properties dump └─ manifest.txt Summary manifest of all collected artifacts ``` --- ## Building from Source ```bash git clone https://github.com/bmjubairdadu/kernel-loader.git cd kernel-loader ./gradlew assembleRelease ``` The release APK will be generated at: `app/build/outputs/apk/release/Kernel-Loader-v2.2.apk` - Language: Kotlin - UI Framework: Jetpack Compose - Root Management: libsu - Target SDK: 34 (Android 14) - Minimum SDK: 28 (Android 9) --- ## Security Model | Security Layer | Implementation | |---|---| | Code Obfuscation | R8 full-mode enabled with aggressive name mangling | | Debugger Protection | Checks `TracerPid` in `/proc/self/status` and `android.os.Debug` | | Instrumentation Guard | Inspects loaded memory maps for Frida (`frida-agent.so`, `/data/local/tmp/re.frida.server`) | | Network Integrity | Cleartext traffic disabled; network requests bypass proxy configurations | | Storage Isolation | Diagnostic staging files isolated in application cache with restricted permissions | --- ## Disclaimer Loading custom kernel modules requires root access and carries inherent risks including device reboots or bootloops if an incompatible module is loaded. While Kernel Loader conducts pre-load validations, users are advised to maintain backups of their boot images. --- ## License Author: [JUBAIR HOSEN](https://github.com/bmjubairdadu) Licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE).

Kernel Loader

Automated Kernel Module Loader and Diagnostic Suite for Android

Detects running kernel · Downloads matching module · In-app verification

![Release](../../releases/latest)

![Platform](#requirements)

![Root](#requirements)

![License: GPL-3.0](LICENSE)

---

Kernel Loader is a root-powered Android application designed to resolve, download, insert, and verify kernel modules (.ko) across Linux kernels 4.9 through 6.12. It matches the exact running kernel against a live OTA driver catalog, verifies real-time physical memory read/write access via an integrated verification binary (Driver.sh), and packages complete hardware diagnostic dumps for custom driver compilation.

---

Key Features

  • **Unified Load Pipeline**: Automatically matches the exact kernel version, downloads the compatible driver from the live OTA repository, and loads it into kernel space.
  • **In-App R/W Verification**: Direct execution of the `Driver.sh` memory engine within the terminal screen to verify physical memory read and write operations.
  • **Detailed Error Reporting**: When a module load fails, the loader extracts and displays the root cause directly from kernel ring buffers (`dmesg`), avoiding generic verification errors.
  • **Diagnostic Report Pack**: Generates a self-contained ZIP archive containing:

    • - Exact boot.img partition dump (detected via active A/B slot and block device mapping).

    - Full kernel symbol table (/proc/kallsyms).

    - Sample OEM vendor module (.ko) with extracted compiler vermagic and configuration.

    - Decompressed kernel configuration (/proc/config.gz or /proc/config).

    - Kernel ring buffer logs (dmesg) and live application logs.

  • **One-Tap Sharing**: Direct integration with WhatsApp and Telegram with full FileProvider permission handling and clip-data propagation.
  • **Security and Hardening**:

    • - Full-mode R8 code shrinking and class obfuscation.

    - Runtime anti-tamper shield detecting Frida, debuggers, ptrace, and Xposed hooks.

    - Network security configuration enforcing direct connections (NO_PROXY).

    ---

    Screenshots

    | Home | Live Terminal |

    |---|---|

    | !Home | !Console |

    ---

    Requirements

    | Component | Requirement |

    |---|---|

    | Root Provider | Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch (Superuser access required) |

    | Architecture | ARM64 (aarch64) |

    | Android Version | Android 9.0 (API level 28) or higher |

    | Connectivity | Internet connection for OTA driver catalog and updates |

    ---

    Execution Workflow

    Tap LOAD
   │
   ├─► Pre-flight validation (Root check, Kernel release, Architecture)
   │
   ├─► OTA catalog resolution (Exact kernel match from repository)
   │
   ├─► Download and integrity verification
   │
   ├─► Staged insmod execution via root shell
   │
   └─► Device node verification and live dmesg validation

    ---

    Diagnostic Report Structure

    When building custom drivers for unsupported kernels, the generated ZIP archive includes:

    report_<device>_<kernel>.zip
├─ boot.img                  Raw boot partition dump (kernel + ramdisk + dtb)
├─ boot_info.txt             Block device path, header version, and sizes
├─ kallsyms.txt              Kernel symbol addresses (/proc/kallsyms)
├─ sample_vendor_module.ko   Real OEM module from /vendor/lib/modules
├─ vendor_modinfo.txt        Compiler version, vermagic, and module info
├─ config.txt                Kernel configuration options (IKCONFIG)
├─ dmesg.txt                 Kernel ring buffer tail and insmod error details
├─ applog.txt                Application execution console log
├─ proc_cmdline.txt          Kernel boot arguments
├─ proc_version.txt          Kernel compiler and toolchain identification
├─ proc_cpuinfo.txt          CPU hardware specifications
├─ device_props.txt          Android system properties dump
└─ manifest.txt              Summary manifest of all collected artifacts

    ---

    Building from Source

    git clone https://github.com/bmjubairdadu/kernel-loader.git
cd kernel-loader
./gradlew assembleRelease

    The release APK will be generated at:

    app/build/outputs/apk/release/Kernel-Loader-v2.2.apk

  • Language: Kotlin
  • UI Framework: Jetpack Compose
  • Root Management: libsu
  • Target SDK: 34 (Android 14)
  • Minimum SDK: 28 (Android 9)

    • ---

    Security Model

    | Security Layer | Implementation |

    |---|---|

    | Code Obfuscation | R8 full-mode enabled with aggressive name mangling |

    | Debugger Protection | Checks TracerPid in /proc/self/status and android.os.Debug |

    | Instrumentation Guard | Inspects loaded memory maps for Frida (frida-agent.so, /data/local/tmp/re.frida.server) |

    | Network Integrity | Cleartext traffic disabled; network requests bypass proxy configurations |

    | Storage Isolation | Diagnostic staging files isolated in application cache with restricted permissions |

    ---

    Disclaimer

    Loading custom kernel modules requires root access and carries inherent risks including device reboots or bootloops if an incompatible module is loaded. While Kernel Loader conducts pre-load validations, users are advised to maintain backups of their boot images.
